algorithm: text-phase tensor-product Gaussian RBF ridge regression, deterministic closed-form dual solve
text_features: 384 embedding coordinates plus constant 1, divided by sqrt(2)
phase_features: 40 Gaussian RBFs, centers uniformly spaced on [0,1], width=1.5/39, multiplied by 4*u*(1-u)
ridge_objective: mean squared training error + lambda * squared Frobenius weight norm
split: zero-based even frames train, odd frames validation within each same demonstration
reconstruction: 15 non-upper-body coordinates stay neutral; 12 mimic coordinates reconstructed algebraically
projection: clip learned active positions to effective hardware limits accounting for mimic children; report raw violations and maximum projection, never hide corrections

acceptance.speed: all named joints at or below existing URDF velocity limit + 1e-8

generation.time_rule: continuous u=t/duration, recompute neural features at each new timestamp; never read old trajectory files during inference

input_policy: existing exact-selector shared guard and complete aliases only; unsupported input returns no positions; learned parameters still depend on actual text embedding, not selected action ID
accepted_scope: same-demonstration temporal interpolation only; paraphrase probes exploratory and separate
limitations: No learning from videos or independent human ASL examples
No new-sign generalization, ASL comprehensibility or clinical validation
Only kinematic sampled-frame checks; no dynamics or continuous collision proof
